html:
When is the best time to visit Ban Gioc waterfall, this is a question that many people are interested in, especially those who are coming to Cao Bang for the first time, so to have the answer, please refer to the article below.

Ban Gioc waterfall is located about 20km from the center of Cao Bang city, known as the most beautiful waterfall, with successive layers pouring down from above through the rocks, creating a beautiful picture.

Ban Gioc waterfall is sometimes dry and sometimes full, so many tourists who are planning to travel to Cao Bang often ask when is the best time to visit Ban Gioc waterfall.

However, according to the locals, the waterfall is often beautiful according to the season, the rainy season in Cao Bang is from June to September, at this time the water flows from above, creating white foam, the water is a bit cloudy.

Traveling to Cao Bang in the dry season is from October to May of the following year, at this time the weather is calmer, the water is calm and clear, very suitable for tourists’ sightseeing journey.

According to backpackers, the best time to travel to Ban Gioc waterfall is from August to September, because at this time the water flows down a lot, creating a beautiful picture.

If you travel to Ban Gioc waterfall combined with watching the ripe rice, you should go to Cao Bang in October, this is also an opportunity to admire the beauty of wild sunflowers, if you are satisfied with the buckwheat flower season, you should go to Cao Bang in November and December.

On the way to Ban Gioc waterfall, visitors will pass through the famous landscapes of Nguom Ngao cave, Thang Hen lake, Pac Po cave… visitors will be able to enjoy the beautiful scenery of the Northeast mountains.

What to eat when traveling to Ban Gioc Waterfall?

Cao Bang Roasted Duck with 7 Flavors

An attractive and delicious dish in Cao Bang, the duck is used with 7 spices before roasting, first marinating the duck with 7 spices of the Tay people.

The flavors are marinated very carefully, because the deliciousness of the meat depends on the seasoning, then use bamboo strips to tightly strung the spices, not letting the spices spill out, then dip in boiling water and brush honey and vinegar on the outside.

When enjoying the skin, it will not be dry and crispy, the meat is soft, the rich aroma will definitely be a delicious dish that you will never forget.

Grilled Tram Huong Fish

A dish that cannot be missed when traveling to Ban Gioc Waterfall, this type of fish is caught right in the river so the meat is firm and delicious, the fish is processed by the people here very deliciously, especially grilled on a charcoal stove, enjoying it in the cold weather in Cao Bang is nothing more interesting.

Smoked sausage

This is a popular dish of the Tay people, the ingredients to make Cao Bang smoked sausage are very unique, lean meat marinated with spices, the same type of fruit, the leaves of the Mac Mat tree, the toughness of the intestines and the meat and skin blend together to bring a delicious flavor unique to the highland cuisine.

Cao Bang smoked sausage can be fried until golden brown, or grilled on a charcoal stove and sliced ​​thinly then served with cucumbers, dipped in delicious chili sauce.

Cao Bang Lam Cake

A dish not to be missed when traveling to Ban Gioc Waterfall, the dough is made by the locals from sticky rice, peanuts, malt and ginger. When you eat it, you will feel the spiciness of ginger, the aroma of honey, the richness of peanuts, the stickiness of sticky rice.

Cao Bang Cake

With carefully selected ingredients, when enjoying you will feel the aroma of sticky rice, the sweetness of rock sugar, the cake filling is made of peanuts and pork fat mixed together to bring a unique delicious flavor.

Chung Khanh Chestnuts

A famous specialty, chestnuts here are very fresh and delicious, if you come to Trung Khanh in the chestnut flower season, you will feel the fragrant scent of flowers, with immense forests, at the end of the year, the fallen chestnuts are collected by the people to sell, so they are very fresh and delicious, visitors can buy them as gifts.
